newFactF5: Under Countable Choice, every Borel subset of $\mathbb R^3$ is Lebesgue measurable; closed coordinate boxes have measure equal to the product of their side lengths; $\lambda_3$ is a measure on the Lebesgue sigma-algebra; and measures are monotone on measurable inclusions. Countable Choice is already part of the transverse-space setting in [F4].
